name: Hooded Lantern
summary: Burns Oil: Bright Light 30 ft, Dim Light 30 ft beyond; hood lowers it to 5 ft of Dim Light.
text: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil to shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for another 30 feet beyond that. One flask of Oil keeps it lit for 6 hours in total. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood so it sheds only Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.
